Expertise

Corporate & Commercial

Advice for the moments that shape a business: starting it, funding it, growing it and selling it.

Discuss a matter

How we help

We advise founders, owners, boards and investors on the transactions and agreements that shape a business.

We keep documents as simple as the deal allows, and we tell you which points matter and which do not.

  • 01Company formation and structuring
  • 02Shareholder and joint venture agreements
  • 03Acquisitions and disposals
  • 04Investment and fundraising rounds
  • 05Commercial contracts and terms of business
  • 06Corporate governance and board advice

When to call us

Situations we help with

  • 01

    You are starting a company with others

    We help co-founders agree ownership, decision-making and what happens if someone leaves, before it matters.

  • 02

    You are raising investment

    We negotiate term sheets, prepare for due diligence and settle the investment documents.

  • 03

    You are buying or selling a business

    We run due diligence, negotiate the deal and take it through to completion.

  • 04

    You need contracts that work

    We write supplier, customer and distribution agreements around how you actually trade.
